tests.name: assertion forms
tests.body: it("chai chains", () => { const x = true; const y = { a: 1 }; expect(x).to.be.true; expect(y).to.deep.equal({ a: 1 }); }); it("should chains", () => { const x = 1; x.should.equal(1); x.should.be.ok; getValue().should.equal(2); }); it("is not an assertion", () => { const a = { b: 1 }; const x = 1; expect(x); expect.extend({ toBeOne(received) { return { pass: received === 1, message: () => "one" }; } }); expect(a).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ b: 1 })); }); it("helpers and nested functions", () => { function check(value: number) { if (value > 1) { return; } expect(value).to.equal(1); } const later = () => { expect(2).to.equal(2); }; check(1); later(); }); it("try, catch and finally", () => { try { expect(1).to.equal(1); } catch (error) { expect(error).to.be.an("error"); } finally { expect(true).to.be.true; } });

tests.name: chai chains
tests.body: const x = true; const y = { a: 1 }; expect(x).to.be.true; expect(y).to.deep.equal({ a: 1 });

tests.name: is not an assertion
tests.body: const a = { b: 1 }; const x = 1; expect(x); expect.extend({ toBeOne(received) { return { pass: received === 1, message: () => "one" }; } }); expect(a).toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ b: 1 }));

tests.name: helpers and nested functions
tests.body: function check(value: number) { if (value > 1) { return; } expect(value).to.equal(1); } const later = () => { expect(2).to.equal(2); }; check(1); later();

tests.name: try, catch and finally
tests.body: try { expect(1).to.equal(1); } catch (error) { expect(error).to.be.an("error"); } finally { expect(true).to.be.true; }
